verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אֲבִיָּ֜ה עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו בְּיָמָ֛יו שָׁקְטָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ ’ă·ḇî·yāh ‘im- ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw bə·‘îr dā·wîḏ way·yim·lōḵ ’ā·sā ḇə·nōw taḥ·tāw bə·yā·māw šā·qə·ṭāh hā·’ā·reṣ ‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: Then Abijah rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David And his son Asa reigned in his place and in his days the land was at peace for ten years
verses.literalPt: Adormeceu Abias com seus pais, e sepultaram-no na Cidade de Davi. Em seu lugar, reinou seu filho Asa, em cujos dias a terra esteve em paz dez anos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אָסָא֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.literal: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God
verses.literalPt: Fez Asa o que era bom e justo aos olhos de Jeová, seu Deus,

verses.original: וַיָּ֛סַר אֶת־ מִזְבְּח֥וֹת הַנֵּכָ֖ר וְהַבָּמ֑וֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־ הַמַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַיְגַדַּ֖ע אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sar ’eṯ- miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ han·nê·ḵār wə·hab·bā·mō·wṯ way·šab·bêr ’eṯ- ham·maṣ·ṣê·ḇō·wṯ way·ḡad·da‘ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·šê·rîm
verses.literal: He removed the foreign altars and high places shattered the sacred pillars and chopped down the Asherah poles
verses.literalPt: porque removeu os altares estranhos e os altos, quebrou as colunas e cortou os Aserins.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לִֽיהוּדָ֔ה לִדְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹרָ֥ה וְהַמִּצְוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî·hū·ḏāh liḏ·rō·wōš ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hat·tō·w·rāh wə·ham·miṣ·wāh
verses.literal: He commanded the people of Judah to seek the LORD the God of their fathers and to observe the law and the commandments
verses.literalPt: Ordenou a Judá que buscasse a Jeová, Deus de seus pais, e observasse a lei e o mandamento.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙סַר֙ מִכָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת־ הַבָּמ֖וֹת וְאֶת־ הַֽחַמָּנִ֑ים וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sar mik·kāl ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh ’eṯ- hab·bā·mō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥam·mā·nîm wat·tiš·qōṭ ham·mam·lā·ḵāh lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: He also removed the high places and incense altars from all the cities of Judah and under him the kingdom was at peace
verses.literalPt: Também de todas as cidades de Judá removeu os altos e as imagens do sol; e sob ele o reino esteve em paz.

verses.original: וַיִּ֛בֶן עָרֵ֥י מְצוּרָ֖ה בִּיהוּדָ֑ה כִּֽי־ שָׁקְטָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֵין־ עִמּ֤וֹ מִלְחָמָה֙ בַּשָּׁנִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כִּֽי־ הֵנִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen ‘ā·rê mə·ṣū·rāh bî·hū·ḏāh kî- šā·qə·ṭāh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ên- ‘im·mōw mil·ḥā·māh baš·šā·nîm hā·’êl·leh kî- hê·nî·aḥ Yah·weh lōw
verses.literal: Because the land was at peace Asa built fortified cities in Judah In those days no one made war with him because the LORD had given him rest
verses.literalPt: Edificou cidades fortificadas em Judá, pois a terra estava em paz, e ele não fazia guerra nesses anos, porque Jeová lhe tinha dado descanso.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לִֽיהוּדָ֜ה נִבְנֶ֣ה׀ אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְנָסֵ֨ב חוֹמָ֣ה וּמִגְדָּלִים֮ דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִיחִים֒ עוֹדֶ֨נּוּ הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנֵ֗ינוּ כִּ֤י דָרַ֙שְׁנוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ דָּרַ֕שְׁנוּ וַיָּ֥נַֽח לָ֖נוּ מִסָּבִ֑יב וַיִּבְנ֖וּ וַיַּצְלִֽיחוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî·hū·ḏāh niḇ·neh ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·nā·sêḇ ḥō·w·māh ū·miḡ·dā·lîm də·lā·ṯa·yim ū·ḇə·rî·ḥîm ‘ō·w·ḏen·nū hā·’ā·reṣ lə·p̄ā·nê·nū kî ḏā·raš·nū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū dā·raš·nū way·yā·naḥ lā·nū mis·sā·ḇîḇ way·yiḇ·nū way·yaṣ·lî·ḥū
verses.literal: So he said to the people of Judah Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers with doors and bars The land is still ours because we have sought the LORD our God We have sought Him and He has given us rest on every side So they built and prospered
verses.literalPt: Disse a Judá: Edifiquemos estas cidades e, ao redor delas, façamos muros e torres, portas e ferrolhos; a terra ainda está diante de nós, porque temos buscado a Jeová, nosso Deus; temo-lo buscado, e ele nos há dado descanso de todos os lados. Edificaram e prosperaram.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְאָסָ֗א חַיִל֮ נֹשֵׂ֣א צִנָּ֣ה וָרֹמַח֒ מִֽיהוּדָה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶףס וּמִבִּנְיָמִ֗ן נֹשְׂאֵ֤י מָגֵן֙ וְדֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת מָאתַ֥יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lə·’ā·sā ḥa·yil nō·śê ṣin·nāh wā·rō·maḥ mî·hū·ḏāh šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ʾɛ·lɛ·p̄s ū·mib·bin·yā·min nō·śə·’ê mā·ḡên wə·ḏō·rə·ḵê qe·šeṯ mā·ṯa·yim ū·šə·mō·w·nîm ’ā·lep̄ kāl- ’êl·leh gib·bō·w·rê ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Asa had an army of 300,000 men . . . . . . from Judah bearing large shields and spears and 280,000 men . . . . . . from Benjamin bearing small shields and drawing the bow All these were mighty men of valor
verses.literalPt: Asa tinha um exército de trezentos mil de Judá, que traziam paveses e lanças; e de Benjamim duzentos e oitenta mil, que traziam escudos e atiravam com arco; todos estes eram ilustres em valor.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם זֶ֣רַח הַכּוּשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֙יִל֙ אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִ֔ים וּמַרְכָּב֖וֹת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וַיָּבֹ֖א עַד־ מָרֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’ă·lê·hem ze·raḥ hak·kū·šî bə·ḥa·yil ’e·lep̄ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·mar·kā·ḇō·wṯ šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- mā·rê·šāh
verses.literal: Then Zerah the Cushite came against them with an army of 1,000,000 men . . . and 300 . . . chariots and they advanced as far as Mareshah
verses.literalPt: Saiu contra ele Zerá, etíope, com um exército de um milhão de homens e trezentos carros; e chegou até Maresa.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א אָסָ֖א לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּֽעַרְכוּ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּגֵ֥יא צְפַ֖תָה לְמָרֵשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’ā·sā lə·p̄ā·nāw way·ya·‘ar·ḵū mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḡê ṣə·p̄a·ṯāh lə·mā·rê·šāh
verses.literal: So Asa marched out against him and lined up in battle formation in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah
verses.literalPt: Então, Asa saiu-lhe ao encontro, e ordenaram a batalha no vale de Zefata, perto de Maresa.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אָסָ֜א אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָיו֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֵֽין־ עִמְּךָ֤ לַעְזוֹר֙ בֵּ֥ין רַב֙ לְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ עָזְרֵ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־ עָלֶ֣יךָ נִשְׁעַ֔נּוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֣ בָ֔אנוּ עַל־ הֶהָמ֖וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אַ֔תָּה אַל־ יַעְצֹ֥ר עִמְּךָ֖ אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ā·sā ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ên- ‘im·mə·ḵā la‘·zō·wr bên raḇ lə·’ên kō·aḥ ‘ā·zə·rê·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū kî- ‘ā·le·ḵā niš·‘an·nū ū·ḇə·šim·ḵā ḇā·nū ‘al- he·hā·mō·wn haz·zeh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’at·tāh ’al- ya‘·ṣōr ‘im·mə·ḵā ’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: Then Asa cried out to the LORD his God . . . O LORD there is no one besides You to help . . . the powerless . . . against the mighty Help us O LORD our God for we rely on You and in Your name we have come against this multitude O LORD You are our God Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You
verses.literalPt: Asa clamou a Jeová, seu Deus, e disse: Além de ti, não há quem ajude o fraco contra o poderoso; ajuda-nos, Jeová, nosso Deus, porque em ti confiamos e em teu nome viemos contra esta multidão. Jeová, tu és nosso Deus; não prevaleça o homem contra ti.

verses.original: וַיִּגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַכּוּשִׁ֔ים לִפְנֵ֥י אָסָ֖א וְלִפְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ הַכּוּשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gōp̄ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hak·kū·šîm lip̄·nê ’ā·sā wə·lip̄·nê yə·hū·ḏāh way·yā·nu·sū hak·kū·šîm
verses.literal: So the LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah and the Cushites fled
verses.literalPt: Feriu Jeová os etíopes diante de Asa e diante de Judá; e os etíopes fugiram.

verses.original: וַיִּרְדְּפֵ֨ם אָסָ֜א וְהָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּוֹ֮ עַד־ לִגְרָר֒ וַיִּפֹּ֤ל מִכּוּשִׁים֙ לְאֵ֣ין לָהֶ֣ם מִֽחְיָ֔ה כִּֽי־ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֣י מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·də·p̄êm ’ā·sā wə·hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- ‘im·mōw ‘aḏ- liḡ·rār way·yip·pōl mik·kū·šîm lə·’ên lā·hem miḥ·yāh kî- niš·bə·rū lip̄·nê- Yah·weh wə·lip̄·nê ma·ḥă·nê·hū way·yiś·’ū šā·lāl har·bêh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Then Asa and his army - pursued them as far as Gerar The Cushites fell and could not . . . recover for they were crushed before the LORD . . . and His army So the people of Judah carried off a great amount of . . . plunder
verses.literalPt: Asa e a gente que estava com ele perseguiram-nos até Gerar (e os etíopes caíram sem poder salvar a vida, porque foram destroçados diante de Jeová e diante do seu exército); e levaram mui grande despojo.

verses.original: וַיַּכּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת גְּרָ֔ר כִּי־ הָיָ֥ה פַֽחַד־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙זּוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים כִּֽי־ בִזָּ֥ה רַבָּ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kū ’êṯ kāl- he·‘ā·rîm sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ gə·rār kî- hā·yāh p̄a·ḥaḏ- Yah·weh ‘ă·lê·hem way·yā·ḇōz·zū ’eṯ- kāl- he·‘ā·rîm kî- ḇiz·zāh rab·bāh hā·yə·ṯāh ḇā·hem
verses.literal: and attacked all the cities around Gerar because the terror of the LORD had fallen upon them They plundered all the cities since there was much plunder there
verses.literalPt: Feriram todas as cidades ao redor de Gerar, porque lhes sobreveio o temor da parte de Jeová, e despojaram todas as cidades, pois nelas havia muita presa.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אָהֳלֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הִכּ֑וּ וַיִּשְׁבּ֨וּ צֹ֤אן לָרֹב֙ וּגְמַלִּ֔ים וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ā·ho·lê miq·neh hik·kū way·yiš·bū ṣōn lā·rōḇ ū·ḡə·mal·lîm way·yā·šu·ḇū yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: They also attacked the tents of the herdsmen and carried off many sheep and camels Then they returned to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Também feriram as malhadas do gado, levaram ovelhas em grande quantidade e camelos e voltaram para Jerusalém.
